document_api_meta.title: Get SPS Overview
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Returns the SPS overview for the authorized shop, including the score, tier, dimensions, benefits, and top issues. 
Shop Performance Score (SPS) reflects a shop’s performance across key operational and service metrics on TikTok Shop. By integrating the read-only SPS APIs, ISVs can retrieve a shop’s score, tier, benefits, and metric benchmarks, diagnose performance gaps, and drill down to the products, logistics providers, aftersales types, orders, or chats associated with specific issues. This enables ISVs to embed actionable performance insights into their solutions, helping merchants identify problem areas faster and take targeted actions to improve shop performance. Available only for US-region shops.
Use case guide: [Click here](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/ph0ccose)

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: locale
request_query_param.desc: BCP 47 locale code used to localize response text. If omitted, the default locale is resolved from the request context.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^benefits
response_param.desc: Fixed complete set of benefits associated with the shop SPS score.

response_param.name: ^^benefit_name
response_param.desc: Benefit display name localized by the requested locale.

response_param.name: ^^is_unlocked
response_param.desc: Whether the shop has unlocked this benefit.

response_param.name: ^^unlock_score
response_param.desc: Score required to unlock the benefit, from 0 to 5.

response_param.name: ^dimensions
response_param.desc: Score details by SPS dimension.

response_param.name: ^^name
response_param.desc: Dimension name.

response_param.name: ^^score
response_param.desc: Dimension score, from 0 to 5.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc: Dimension status enum. Possible values include EXCELLENT, GOOD, POOR, CRITICAL and NIL.

response_param.name: ^^status_text
response_param.desc: Dimension status text. Values like Excellent, Good, Normal, Attention.

response_param.name: ^^weight
response_param.desc: Dimension weight as a percent from 0 to 100.

response_param.name: ^evaluate_duration_days
response_param.desc: The number of days included in the score evaluation period.

response_param.name: ^end_evaluation_time
response_param.desc: The evaluation period end time. Unix timestamp in seconds.

response_param.name: ^start_evaluation_time
response_param.desc: The evaluation period start time. Unix timestamp in seconds.

response_param.name: ^peer_percentile
response_param.desc: The shop's percentile among peers, from 0 to 100.

response_param.name: ^primary_category
response_param.desc: The shop's primary category.

response_param.name: ^^category_id
response_param.desc: The primary category ID.

response_param.name: ^^category_name
response_param.desc: The primary category name.

response_param.name: ^sps_score
response_param.desc: The shop SPS score, from 0 to 5 with one decimal place.

response_param.name: ^sps_tier
response_param.desc: The SPS tier. Possible values include EXCELLENT, GOOD, POOR, CRITICAL and NIL.

response_param.name: ^sps_tier_text
response_param.desc: The SPS tier. Values like Excellent, Good, Normal, Attention.

response_param.name: ^top_issues
response_param.desc: Top SPS issues that contributed to the current score.

response_param.name: ^^issues
response_param.desc: Ranked issue list.

response_param.name: ^^^description
response_param.example: Your on-time delivery performance is lower than peer shops.
response_param.desc: Localized issue description.

response_param.name: ^^^evaluate_duration_days
response_param.desc: Number of days included in this issue's evaluation period.

response_param.name: ^^^end_evaluation_time
response_param.desc: Issue evaluation period end time. Unix timestamp in seconds.

response_param.name: ^^^start_evaluation_time
response_param.desc: Issue evaluation period start time. Unix timestamp in seconds.

response_param.name: ^^^metric_code
response_param.desc: Related metric code. Possible values include NRR, NBFR, SFCR, OTDR, AHT, and IM_DSAT.

response_param.name: ^^^metric_name
response_param.desc: Localized metric display name.

response_param.name: ^^^percentile
response_param.desc: Metric percentile among peer shops, from 0 to 100.

response_param.name: ^^^rank
response_param.desc: Issue rank, where 1 is the top issue.

response_param.name: ^^summary
response_param.example: Improve late dispatch and negative reviews to increase your SPS score.
response_param.desc: Localized summary of the top issues.

response_param.name: ^update_time
response_param.desc: The latest score refresh time. Unix timestamp in seconds.

scope_list.package_description: The application will be able to access TikTok shop analytics such as live and video, GMV, orders and content traffic data such as CTR, visitors for a shop and products in shop.
scope_list.auth_info: The application will be able to access your prior and go-forward TikTok Shop sales and traffic data by Shop and product, including but not limited to GMV, Number of orders, units sold, Number of buyers, product listings, product impressions and page views, Number of visitors, and click through rate (CTR), all by content type (video, live and product card).
